description: This script connects to a MongoDB database, lists all collections, and displays up to 10 documents from each collection for inspection. It handles environment variables, connection setup, and error handling, serving as a utility for database inspection and debugging within the project.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Prints a formatted section header to organize output.

methods.name: maskMongoUri
methods.description: Masks sensitive credentials in a MongoDB URI for safe logging.

methods.name: dbNameFromUriPath
methods.description: Extracts the database name from the URI path component.

methods.name: fetchFirstNFromCollection
methods.description: Fetches the first N documents from a specified collection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that orchestrates the connection, listing, and display of database collections and documents.
